mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, leading to potential monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, which in turn negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 60% of the instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 70% of the instances when UNRATE < 4% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 50% of the instances when RSAFS is increasing over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side of the economy, which can lead to reduced corporate earnings and negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 60% of the instances when INDPRO MoM < 0% over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, which can lead to higher consumer spending and positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 50% of the instances when both PAYEMS and UNRATE signal a strong labor market over a 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) indicates a strong demand in the housing market, which can lead to increased economic activity and positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 60% of the instances when HOUST MoM > 5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals an accommodative monetary policy, which can lead to increased investment and positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 50% of the instances when FEDFUNDS < 1% over a 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP (GDPC1) signals a weakening economy, which can lead to reduced corporate earnings and negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 60% of the instances when GDPC1 QoQ < 0% over a 3-year rolling window.
